work.title: The ones that taught me the most

ekyc.title: AI-Powered eKYC & Risk Intelligence on MOSIP
ekyc.description: An identity document verification system integrated into MOSIP's government-grade identity infrastructure, with a multi-stage fraud detection pipeline. Honorable Mention for Best Real-World Application at ProjectFest 2026.
details: Multi-stage fraud detection pipeline combining metadata forensics and pixel-level tampering detection.
OCR extraction with MRZ validation for machine-readable travel documents.
Document templating system for structured field extraction via homography alignment.
Honorable Mention, Best Real-World Application, Infosys InStep Annual ProjectFest 2026.

mazza.title: DJ Mazza Press Kit
mazza.description: Single-page press kit in React 19 with a 3D hero logo in Three.js, vectorized from the client's PNG with Python and OpenCV at a 0.997 IoU silhouette match.
details: React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind 4, Motion and Lenis.
3D hero logo in Three.js, vectorized from the client's PNG with Python/OpenCV (0.997 IoU silhouette match).
Static prerendering delivers full HTML without JavaScript for a fast first paint.
Lazy-loaded SoundCloud and YouTube players fed by RSS at build time.
WebGL and reduced-motion fallbacks, plus 11 automated Playwright smoke tests.

hunter.title: Hunter BarberShop
hunter.description: Single-page site for a local barbershop. Services, reviews, gallery, WhatsApp, social and map links live in one data layer, so the client updates content without touching components.
details: React 19, TypeScript and Tailwind 4.
Services, reviews, gallery, WhatsApp, social and map links configured from one data layer.
The client can update content without touching components.
Deployed on Netlify.

agent.title: AI Browser Agent
agent.description: Agentic RAG system that crawls any URL with headless Chromium, embeds it into a FAISS store and answers questions through LLaMA 3.3 70B, digging into sub-pages when retrieval confidence drops.
details: Crawls any URL with headless Chromium/Playwright and embeds content with all-MiniLM-L6-v2 into a FAISS vector store.
Answers through Groq-hosted LLaMA 3.3 70B, served via a FastAPI backend and a Gradio frontend.
Multi-iteration agent loop with cosine-similarity link ranking that scrapes relevant sub-pages when retrieval confidence falls below a threshold.
Manual JSON tool-calling to bypass Groq server-side parsing limits, plus cross-iteration chunk deduplication.

petsride.title: Pets-Ride
petsride.description: Full-stack pet services platform: a secure Node.js/Express REST API with JWT and role-based access over a normalized PostgreSQL schema, and a component-driven React frontend.
details: Secure REST API in Node.js/Express with stateless JWT authentication and role-based access control.
Normalized PostgreSQL schema that keeps service bookings transactionally consistent.
Component-driven React/Vite frontend with Tailwind CSS and Material-UI.
API calls centralized through Axios interceptors for consistent error handling and token management.

katas.title: DJ Katas Press Kit
katas.description: Lightweight press kit in plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JavaScript, with Google Search Console verification set up for discoverability.
details: Plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JavaScript, no framework.
Google Search Console verification set up for discoverability.
